answer: A behavior-fingerprint escrow bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and files a fingerprint on a comet ledger. Auditors whisper a challenge each epoch; sign it in one hour and match the fingerprint, or the escrow burns. Comet sweeps replay 5% of prints; rented hands fail and both burn. First print 45, k-th 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,112,000 with locks, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45, earn 20 nectar per clean epoch.
